project_name: CloudIVR Marketing Landing & Live Operations Platform
archetype: Clean Editorial Swiss & High-Contrast Ink (cm.com style)

theme_strategy.landing_hero: Pure White (#ffffff) background, near-black ink typography (#0f172a / #000000), crisp dark buttons
theme_strategy.landing_body: Minimalist White & Light Slate (#ffffff & #f8fafc) alternating sections, zero checker patterns, zero purple gradients
theme_strategy.live_dashboard: Dark Command Center Obsidian (#0a0a0a with #141414 cards, #34d399 emerald, #818cf8 indigo, #fbbf24 amber)

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.1] text-center
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 text-center

component_styles.button_primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm
component_styles.button_secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all
component_styles.nav_bar: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-900
component_styles.tab_bar: bg-slate-100 p-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 inline-flex gap-2
component_styles.browser_frame: rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-2xl overflow-hidden

landing_page_structure.sticky_nav: Logo + Products & Use Cases mega dropdowns + Coverage, Pricing, FAQ + EN/FR/ES language switcher + Sign in + Get your number CTA

centered_hero.eyebrow: BEHIND EVERY CALL — CLOUD PHONE INFRASTRUCTURE
centered_hero.h1: Every call answered. Every lead called.
centered_hero.subheadline: Instant phone numbers in 17 countries, visual keypad IVR menus, outbound phone campaigns, and AI voice agents.

product_tabs.behavior: Auto-advancing progress bar showing dark UI screenshots (#0a0a0a) inside a clean light browser-window frame

sections: Facts Strip (Key metrics on light background)
The Platform (Interactive feature picker with mockups)
Coverage Grid (17 countries with pricing & capabilities)
Final CTA Banner & Clean Multi-column Footer

live_page_map_spec.container_style: bg-[#141414] border border-[#222222] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-xl text-white mb-8

map_visuals.projection: US Interactive State Map (SVG map with shaded paths based on call density)
map_visuals.live_dots: Glowing cyan (#38bdf8) and emerald (#34d399) pulsing call nodes positioned on state centroids with CSS ping animation representing active ringing/talking calls
map_visuals.tooltip: Hover card showing state name, today's call volume, answer rate %, and currently ringing count
map_visuals.legend: Color gradient bar for call intensity + pulsing dots indicator for live active calls

live_page_map_spec.outside_us_panel: Side/Bottom widget listing Canada provinces and international live traffic summary
live_page_map_spec.dashboard_position: Sits directly above the live call feed table and campaign pipeline queues

live_dashboard.theme: Dark Command Center Obsidian (#0a0a0a with #141414 cards, #34d399 emerald, #818cf8 indigo, #fbbf24 amber)

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling engine on marketing pages

explicit_do_not_list: NO deep purple or violet backgrounds/gradients anywhere on the landing page.
NO grid, mesh, or checkerboard background pattern overlays.
NO colored background glow blobs or heavy gradients.
NO fully transparent backgrounds for header nav or dropdown menus.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and nav links MUST include data-testid in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain high contrast ink-on-paper aesthetic inspired by cm.com.
Keep landing page background pure white (#ffffff) with light slate (#f8fafc) section highlights.
Ensure dark screenshots are framed inside light browser containers.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
